test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 27 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

m n _ m n _ o m _ m _ n n o m _ m m _ n o

options.text: m n n m n n
o n n m n n
m n o m n n
m n n m o o

solution:
In the above series,

**Option 1.**

mn**__m__**mn**__n__**o / m**__n__**m**__m__**nno / m**__n__**mm__n__no

**Option 2.**

mn**__o__**mn**__n__**o / m__n__m__m__nno / m__n__mm__n__no

**Option 3.**

mn__m__mn__n__o / m**__o__**m__m__nno / m__n__mm__n__no

**Option 4.**

mn__m__mn__n__o / m__n__m__m__nno / m**__o__**mm**__o__**no

Only** option(1) **follows a common pattern m and n come 3 times and O comes once at the end. 

The complete series is as follows mn**__m__**mn**__n__**o/m**__n__**m**__m__**nno/m**__n__**mm**__n__**no

Hence, the correct answer is an **option (1)**
